candidates.name: testicular torsion
support_spans: No torsion was evident in the sperm vessels
contradict_spans: No torsion was evident in the sperm vessels
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings could have suggested testicular torsion, but it was ruled out.

candidates.name: orchitis

candidates.why: The patient presented with an enlarged testis and imaging findings consistent with orchitis.

candidates.name: pyocele
support_spans: purulent foci were visible on the surface of the vessels
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings could have suggested a pyocele, which is a collection of pus in the scrotum.
